title: Clean a results file
description: Implement summarise(path). Read a CSV file with header name,score. Ignore records with a missing name, a non-integer score, or a score outside 0–100. Return [valid_count, total_score]. Strip surrounding spaces. Use the supplied file in the Files tab; each test starts with fresh files.
hints: csv.DictReader uses the header as field names.
Validate each record before adding to the total.

files.results.csv:
name,score
Ari,78
Mei,100
Jo,0
Kai,101
,50
Sam,absent
